name: Blastr - Soundboard
detailed_description:
Blastr is the ultimate soundboard for Discord, online gaming, and trolling your squad into oblivion. Whether you're mid-clutch in CS:GO or vibing in a Minecraft Discord server, Blastr lets you blast meme sounds, troll effects, and voice clips straight into voice chat with zero friction.

Designed for gamers, streamers, and certified keyboard comedians, Blastr is a custom soundboard app built for voice chat domination.

Main features

  • Works in any voice chat app or game (Discord, Fortnite, Valorant, etc.)

  • Soundboard with hotkeys, presets, and quick action bar

  • Folders to keep your chaos organized

  • Browser plugin for instant sound imports—because nobody has time to download and drag files manually anymore.

Whether you're looking for the best soundboard of 2025, a Voicemod alternative, or just want a quick way to drop the "brrr brrr patapim" sound, Blastr’s got your back.

Perfect for Discord trolls, online gamers, and anyone who thinks timing a fart noise during a team speech is peak comedy.

How the browser plugin work / Quickly add sounds

1 - Download the Chrome plug-in ( link in the app / on our website / in Chrome Web Store )

2 - ( optional ) Change download location in settings

3 - Click the big button on compatible websites or manually add the link

4 - profit ?

Make it your soundboard

Because being a troll involves quantity, make it truly yours. Organize your memes your way ( if it end ups looking bad it’s on you ).

Questions & Answers

Q - Can it get me banned in games ?
Not for cheating. For spamming obsceneties ( a.k.a gamer words ) like and idiot, yes ( you know what you did you silly billy )

Q - How do I setup Blastr to work in my games ?
In the microphone / input selector, you pick VB-Cable output and you're done !

Q - Does this affect my microphone settings ?
No

Q - Can it destroy my sound card
No

Q - What are the files compatibility
.mp3 / .mp4 / .Wav /

Q - Does this affect my recordings ?
You can chose to either include Blastr into your audio recordings or not depending on the option you select in input.  ( Yes - VB cable output ) ( No - YourMicrophone )

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel or AMD 1GHz or faster
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: A sound card must be installed
